name: Company RSS & Press Release Monitor - Every 12 Hours

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, website FROM companies WHERE website IS NOT NULL LIMIT 50

parameters.columns: company_id, title, url, content, published_date, source, category, raw_data

parameters.query: UPDATE scraper_state SET last_run_at = NOW(), last_success_at = NOW() WHERE scraper_name = 'company_rss_monitor'
